SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(fiscal_week) AS w1, MAX(fiscal_week) AS w2, MIN(calendar_date) AS d1, MAX(calendar_date) AS d2, COUNT(*) AS days, SUM(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trading_days
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
    AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
),
dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM base GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1),
ctrl AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN business_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END AS yr, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_gross, SUM(returns_net) AS ctrl_ret, SUM(net_sales) AS ctrl_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE store_id<900 AND (business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
  GROUP BY 1
),
mine AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END AS yr, SUM(net_amount) AS my_gross, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
  FROM base GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.yr, m.n_lines, m.n_ids, m.max_load, m.my_gross, c.ctrl_gross, c.ctrl_ret, c.ctrl_net, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dups) AS dup_keys
FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (yr) ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.open_date, s.close_date, s.is_current,
  (SELECT string_agg(closure_type || ' ' || CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) || '..' || CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR), '; ') FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=s.store_id) AS closures,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_store x WHERE x.store_id=s.store_id) AS versions
FROM dim_store s
WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900 AND (s.open_date IS NOT NULL OR s.close_date IS NOT NULL OR s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure))
ORDER BY 1

lfl_store_weeks AS (

    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading

net_lines AS (

lfl_sales AS (

    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year)
SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ty.stores AS lfl_stores, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM params JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
